summary.name: Nik Collection
summary.one_liner: Nik Collection 9 is a photo editing suite of plugins by DxO for Windows and macOS that works with Photoshop, Affinity, and DxO PhotoLab or on its own.
use_cases: photo editing with Affinity or DxO PhotoLab
summary.what_it_does: Nik Collection 9 is described as a suite of photo editing tools with exclusive color tools and a digital darkroom for black and white images. It integrates with Photoshop, Affinity, and DxO PhotoLab, and can also be used on its own. The page lists seven creative tools in one toolbox and a feature for sharing edits. The page does not list specific tool names or detailed features beyond these claims.
notable: Plugin integration with Photoshop, Affinity, and DxO PhotoLab, or standalone
Digital darkroom for black and white images
Seven creative tools in one toolbox
caveats: Platforms listed are Windows and macOS only
Pricing is not stated on the page
